data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 魂灯夜话·「谢谢你……愿意来冥界看我」
data.description: 幽蓝的魂灯顺流漂向远方，埃列什基伽勒与你并肩坐在河畔的黑曜石上。她抱着膝盖，声音轻轻的——「以前的我，只能等别人死后来这里。……现在会有一个人，特意活着跑来看我。这种事……比整个冥界都重哦。谢谢你。」
data.action: 抱膝坐岸边看魂灯漂流，轻声道谢红瞳湿润
data.camera: wide two-shot, two clothed companions seated on the riverbank
data.promptProse: Seated beside a companion in a travel coat, she hugs her knees and quietly thanks them. Blue soul lanterns drift along the river below the two figures, reflected light catching her damp eyes.
data.animaCaption: She sits beside her clothed companion as blue soul lanterns drift along the river below them.
